findings.message: slide 6 ('Configuring Custom Tools via MCP'): [fact] The speaker notes cite a fabricated future study ('2026 SSRN paper') and an invented statistic (37% reduction in integration failures). Fix: Remove the citation and fake statistic from the speaker notes. (rewritten to fix this; not re-read by the reviewer)

slide 6 ('Configuring Custom Tools via MCP'): [fact] The notes describe MCP registration as a POST request to a registry service, misrepresenting the Model Context Protocol which operates via JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio/SSE between host and server. Fix: Clarify that MCP tools are exposed directly by local or remote MCP servers to client hosts over JSON-RPC transport rather than registered via a central REST API endpoint. (rewritten to fix this; not re-read by the reviewer)
